title: Schedule comparison under exponential forgetting
purpose: Primary contrast greedy vs uniform at the central setting; secondary contrasts expanding, leitner, massed vs uniform
primary_outcome: Mean true-model recall at delayed test R (probability, higher better)
planned_analysis: Paired differences over 50 seeds; 95% percentile bootstrap (10000); paired t cross-check; Holm over secondary contrasts

title: Oracle advantage and model misspecification under power-law forgetting
purpose: Principal invalidation test: greedy with matched (power) and misspecified (exponential) model vs uniform
primary_outcome: Mean true-model recall at delayed test R
planned_analysis: Paired differences over 50 seeds; bootstrap 95% intervals; Holm over two primary contrasts

title: Robustness sweep over models budgets retention intervals and item distributions
purpose: Descriptive check of rank stability across 54 cells
primary_outcome: Mean true-model recall at delayed test R per cell and arm rank
planned_analysis: Descriptive: per-cell bootstrap intervals (unadjusted, labelled), share of seeds where each arm ranks first
